// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/agent-collaboration: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface AgentCollaborationCondition {
    kind: "node" | "envelope" | "command" | "pending" | "external";
    ref: string;
    label: string;
    last: {
        status: AgentCollaborationObservation;
        at: string;
        note?: string;
        checker_error?: string;
    };
}

export type AgentCollaborationControl = {
    kind: "cancel-wait";
    wait_id: string;
    note?: string;
} | {
    kind: "continue-now";
    wait_id: string;
    note?: string;
};

export type AgentCollaborationControlInput = AgentCollaborationControl & {
    runtime_id: string;
};

export type AgentCollaborationObservation = "pending" | "satisfied" | "failed" | "unknown";

export interface AgentCollaborationPort {
    read(project: string, sessionId?: string): Promise<AgentCollaborationSessionView[]>;
    awaitReady(project: string, timeoutMs: number, exclude?: string[], signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentCollaborationSessionView[]>;
    control(project: string, control: AgentCollaborationControl, actorId: string): Promise<AgentCollaborationSessionView>;
    revise(run: AgentRunRef, amendment: AgentStepAmendment, expectedVersion: number, actorId: string): Promise<AgentStepBoard>;
    works?: AgentWorkGraphPort;
}

export interface AgentCollaborationReadInput {
    runtime_id: string;
    session_id?: string;
}

export interface AgentCollaborationReviseInput {
    runtime_id: string;
    session_id: string;
    run_id: string;
    amendment: AgentStepAmendment;
    expected_version: number;
}

export interface AgentCollaborationSessionView {
    session_id: string;
    wait?: AgentCollaborationWait;
    continuation?: AgentContinuationView;
}

export interface AgentCollaborationWait {
    wait_id: string;
    session_id: string;
    run_id?: string;
    graph_id: string;
    node_id: string;
    by: "agent" | "app";
    reason: string;
    mode: "all" | "any";
    until: "success" | "settled";
    on_failure: "block" | "continue";
    deadline_at: string;
    conditions: AgentCollaborationCondition[];
    state: AgentCollaborationWaitState;
    continued?: true;
    created_at: string;
    settled_at?: string;
    note?: string;
}

export type AgentCollaborationWaitState = "waiting" | "satisfied" | "failed" | "expired" | "cancelled" | "needs-reconciliation";

export type AgentContinuationState = "armed" | "eligible" | "claimed" | "started" | "blocked" | "cancelled" | "needs-reconciliation";

export interface AgentContinuationView {
    graph_id: string;
    node_id: string;
    session_id: string;
    request_key: string;
    state: AgentContinuationState;
    auto: boolean;
    run_id?: string;
    reason?: {
        code: string;
        note?: string;
    };
}

export interface AgentWorkGraphPort {
    open(input: {
        key: string;
        session_id: string;
        title: string;
    }): Promise<{
        graph_id: string;
    }>;
    add(input: {
        graph_id: string;
        node_id: string;
        under?: string;
        session_id: string;
        title: string;
        wait_reason?: string;
    }): Promise<void>;
    read(graph_id: string): Promise<AgentWorkNode[]>;
    watch(graph_id: string, listener: () => void): () => void;
    end(input: {
        graph_id: string;
        node_id: string;
        note: string;
        actor_id?: string;
    }): Promise<void>;
    hold(input: {
        graph_id: string;
        note: string;
    }): Promise<void>;
    onReady(listener: (ready: {
        graph_id: string;
        request_key: string;
    }) => void): () => void;
}

export interface AgentWorkNode {
    node_id: string;
    parent?: string;
    title: string;
    state: "not-started" | "ready" | "running" | "waiting" | "blocked" | "needs-reconciliation" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "cancelled";
    session_id?: string;
    ended_by_person?: {
        at: string;
        note: string;
    };
    ended_at?: string;
    continuation?: {
        request_key: string;
        state: AgentContinuationState;
    };
}

export declare const agentCollaborationActions: {
    readonly read: ActionDefinition<AgentCollaborationReadInput, {
        sessions: AgentCollaborationSessionView[];
    }>;
    readonly control: ActionDefinition<AgentCollaborationControlInput, {
        session: AgentCollaborationSessionView;
    }>;
    readonly revise: ActionDefinition<AgentCollaborationReviseInput, {
        board: AgentStepBoard;
    }>;
};

export declare const servicesAgentCollaborationContract: {
    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.service.agent-collaboration.v1";
    readonly kind: "service";
    readonly schemaVersion: 1;
    readonly maturity: "partial";
    readonly ssot: "specs/prologue-adoption/spec.md";
};
